description: This Java source file defines the ContactsFragment class, which is an Android UI Fragment demonstrating access to the device's contacts through the Contacts ContentProvider API. It allows displaying the first contact, loading contacts, and inserting a dummy contact, primarily for illustrating runtime permissions handling.

classes.name: ContactsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that interacts with the Contacts ContentProvider API to display and add contacts, mainly for illustrating runtime permission usage.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ContactsFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up button click listeners for loading contacts and adding a dummy contact.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Restarts the Loader to query the Contacts content provider.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to query contacts sorted by display name.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Displays the first contact's name and contact count after loading completes.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets the display message when loader is reset.

methods.name: insertDummyContact
methods.description: Inserts a dummy contact into the device's contacts database.
